headline: Sell AUD after the jobs miss (EURAUD and GBPAUD long) and buy USDCAD on dips; avoid chasing oversold AUD and USD-major lows.
market_summary: USD is the dominant daily trend (DXY RSI 77, USD Leading on the daily RRG) but is cooling intraday, and most USD majors are oversold on 4H with bullish divergences. Risk tone is off: VIX near 25 and equity indices deeply oversold, with JPY bid against everything except USD. AUD is the weakest currency after Oct jobs printed -43.5K vs +25K, and Technical, Flow and Macro agree on expressing it through EUR and GBP crosses rather than chasing AUDUSD at RSI 23. COT warns that AUD shorts and JPY/CHF longs are already crowded, so entries are on pullbacks.

horizon_view.1d: Retest of the 1.64566 breakout high after the rejection bar; GBP/EUR events not until Mon.
horizon_view.3d: Best horizon: AUD weakness and EUR spread widening (+20.1bp 4w) carry it about 0.6 sigma higher.
horizon_view.5d: Still favoured, but Wed 07:30 AUD CPI can reverse AUD; trim before it.

ideas.thesis: EUR is improving on the 4H RRG while AUD is lagging on both timeframes after a big jobs miss. The pair broke its 20-bar high with a bullish SMA stack and a daily uptrend, and retail is only 33.6% long with shorts 285 pips under water.
